lead: President Tinubu returned to Lagos after his working vacation in France, saying he had enjoyed himself, as the National Assembly resumed with the state police bill and the 2027 budget on its agenda. NNPC reported a N7.2 trillion profit for 2025, the government warned of flood risk in 24 states and the FCT, and Abia police found 28 human skulls in forest camps. Guinea-Bissau beat the Super Eagles 3-0 in Bissau, Isa Pantami won the rerun Gombe PDP primary, and troops rescued 41 abducted travellers in Zamfara.

items.h: Tinubu returns to Lagos after European vacation
items.s: The President arrived at the presidential wing of Murtala Muhammed Airport after leaving Paris, and said he enjoyed the break.

items.h: NNPC posts N7.2trn profit for 2025
items.s: Group chief executive Bashir Ojulari presented the 2025 audited accounts on Tuesday.

items.h: National Assembly resumes with state police bill and 2027 budget
items.s: Senate President Akpabio also urged security agencies to step up efforts to rescue people held captive.

items.h: Flood alert for 24 states and FCT
items.s: The government warned of possible flooding between 27 September and 10 October.

items.h: Abia police find 28 human skulls in forest camps
items.s: Officers recovered skulls and bones from two suspected criminal camps in the Isuochi forests, Umunneochi.

items.h: Guinea-Bissau beat Super Eagles 3-0
items.s: Nigeria suffered a heavy defeat in their second 2027 AFCON qualifier in Bissau.

items.h: Pantami wins rerun Gombe PDP governorship primary
items.s: The Wike-backed faction held the court-ordered primary on Tuesday.

items.h: Troops rescue 41 abducted travellers in Zamfara
items.s: Bandits had seized the travellers on the highway in Tsafe.

items.h: Reps extend 2025 capital budget to 31 December
items.s: It is the fourth extension of the 2025 Appropriation Act.

items.h: Three more Nigerians killed in South Africa
items.s: The consulate in Johannesburg asked authorities to investigate the deaths.

items.h: Dangote shrugs off Kenyan court halt on Lamu refinery
items.s: He called the order normal in Africa and said the group is ready for trouble-makers.

items.h: Atiku demands publication of Nigeria-US health deal
items.s: He cited Ghana's rejection of a similar agreement.

items.h: Atiku and APM oppose new $1.5bn World Bank loan
items.s: The APM asked lenders to reject the request, and Atiku said past borrowing must be accounted for.

items.h: ADC promises Atiku will not be an absentee president
items.s: The campaign contrasted its candidate with Tinubu's long absence.

items.h: Otedola praises Tinubu's reforms after Paris dinner
items.s: The First HoldCo chairman called them bold and forward-thinking.

items.h: Emir Sanusi questions El-Rufai's prolonged detention
items.s: He asked whether it is a political battle.

items.h: Rivers Assembly endorses state police amendment
items.s: Lawmakers voted unanimously.

items.h: Four kidnappers sentenced to death in Edo
items.s: A special court in Benin City convicted the syndicate.

items.h: Nine-hour downpour floods Makurdi homes
items.s: Residents were left stranded on Monday.

items.h: Three women killed at Plateau mining site
items.s: Gunmen attacked Rakum community in Barkin Ladi.

items.h: Anambra to prosecute those who deny women inheritance
items.s: Offenders risk four years in jail.

items.h: FG releases approved textbook list for 2026-2028
items.s: Approved titles carry QR tracking codes.

items.h: UBEC adopts whole-school approach in 10-year plan
items.s: Implementation begins in October.

items.h: Laws to be translated into indigenous languages
items.s: The National Assembly will publish them in Hausa, Igbo, Yoruba and others.

items.h: NEDC projects in North-East reach N1.5trn
items.s: The commission said ongoing and planned works have grown.

items.h: NNPC says no date for IPO
items.s: The decision rests with shareholders.

items.h: Group urges NASS to pass reserved seats bill
items.s: Centre LSD said lawmakers should not close shop without it.

items.h: Barau sacks another aide
items.s: Rashida Adamu was dismissed over alleged anti-APC activities.

items.h: Makinde and Hamzat set out agendas
items.s: Makinde said Nigeria can be reset in four years; Hamzat outlined investment plans for Lagos.

items.h: NGX and Nairobi exchange plan closer ties
items.s: Stakeholders met in Nairobi.

items.h: Eguavoen names Super Falcons squad for Comoros
items.s: 28 players were called up for the Olympic qualifier.

items.h: FirstBank says its mobile app is secure
items.s: It dismissed a WhatsApp claim of a breach.
